model_output.verdict: A mid-market account executive with a promotion, quota attainment, and a referral program that sourced deals.
write_up: This is a strong sales resume! Your move from SDR to account executive is easy to follow, and you show both quota attainment and deals sourced through payroll partners. A recruiter can see what you sell, who you sell to, and what you've closed.

The $1.1M new annual recurring revenue line is the model: it puts your sales result beside your quota attainment. Your experience comes before education, and the promotion is clear in both the headline and job history.

Let's sharpen your part in demos and security reviews, then add the meeting count and the measure behind your SDR ranking. Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a call back; the competitiveness of a particular role will also matter.

cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as the model. It gives the recruiter a concrete sales figure, a year, and a benchmark in one line.

fit.note: Your experience points most directly to mid-market account executive roles selling HR software. The SDR promotion and full-cycle sales work support that direction.
